name: NCAA D-III Mideast Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Manchester, CT · host Trinity · Wickham Park
headline: NCAA D-III Mideast Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Five ranked teams in each race. Women: No. 2 Williams, No. 3 Middlebury, No. 17 Vassar, No. 22 Connecticut College and No. 24 Wesleyan. Men: No. 6 RPI, No. 14 Amherst, No. 16 Williams, No. 18 Wesleyan and No. 24 Middlebury. Nationals bids are on the line for the NCAA D-III Championships on Nov. 21 in Northfield, Minn. · Women 6K 11:00 a.m. ET · Men 8K 12:00 p.m. ET
